title: Preparing for a video consultation
text: Keep your symptoms, current medicines, allergies and recent reports ready. Choose a quiet, well-lit place and use a reliable internet connection.

title: Understanding blood pressure
text: Blood pressure readings have two numbers. Keep a record of readings taken correctly and discuss repeated abnormal readings with a clinician.

title: Child fever basics
text: Keep a child hydrated and monitor temperature. Seek urgent medical care for breathing difficulty, seizures, severe dehydration, unusual sleepiness or other emergency signs.

title: Healthy sleep routine
text: A consistent sleep and wake time, reduced late caffeine and a calm pre-sleep routine can support healthy sleep.

title: Medicine safety
text: Keep medicines in their original packaging, check expiry dates and never share prescription medicines.

title: When to seek emergency help
text: Severe chest pain, severe breathing difficulty, sudden weakness, heavy bleeding, seizures or loss of consciousness require urgent emergency care.
